blocks.x: Operators monetize networks that already know everything: telemetry into predictive ops, experience data into churn saves, energy telemetry into cost control, and edge assets into compute products. The intelligence layer is the strategy. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in network operations (noc), retention/save offers, field workforce dispatch, with energy management close behind. The paths are busy; the decisions are late. Closing that delay is worth more than any single tool purchase.
named from the floor, not from a framework, Network Operators (CSPs) edition:

items: Element alarms flood; correlation manual; customer-impacting events found by tickets.
Retention offers monthly; in-quarter intent signals ignored.
SS7/Diameter and API surfaces nation-grade; monitoring thin.
Per-site energy uninstrumented; ESG reporting manual.
SIM/eSIM/core keys face PQ exposure; inventory unknown.
IVR containment metric masks unresolved contacts; cost and CSAT both worse.
